WHO WE ARE

A clearer picture of every box and every dollar.

We started Invenstory after watching a family hardware shop lose two weeks of margin to a stock sheet nobody trusted. So we built the boring, reliable system we wished they had: stock in, stock out, profit — counted the moment it happens, explained without a single spreadsheet.

— The Invenstory team, Rotterdam

Inbound tracking

Log every delivery as it lands. Suppliers, batches, unit costs and landed price stay attached to the stock you actually have on the shelf.

Receiving · Costing

Outbound tracking

Scan or punch out goods and the stock, invoice and margin update together — no end-of-day reconciliation, no guessing what left the yard.

Profit tracking
